task.subject: A delegated work-item review workflow for repositories managed through githubnext/gh-aw-cao
task.intent: Let an operator see whether a delegated work-item review workflow is activating on stable work items that require operator review, producing bounded review outputs, and attaining its intended value of resolving review-eligible work items with accepted evidence.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a standalone delegated work-item review workflow on githubnext/gh-aw-cao.
A stable delegated work item enters a lifecycle state and next action that requires operator review within the selected horizon.
A workflow run associated with that review queue is observed in the dashboard horizon.
requiredEffects: For each review-eligible work item opportunity, the workflow evaluates the delegated work item and emits at most one bounded safe review output tied to that same repository and workflow scope.

Accepted repository evidence must remain limited to the delegated work item state, any linked outcome for the same repository and workflow, and the workflow run provenance for that review opportunity.
The workflow must leave work items that are already resolved, waiting on another actor, or lack sufficient evidence without a new durable output.
noopConditions: The work item is already verified or ended before the workflow evaluates it.
The work item is waiting on another actor or has no next action for the repository operator.
A prior accepted workflow output already covers the same review opportunity.
successConditions: The workflow activates for review-eligible work items within the selected horizon.
Observed outcomes for eligible review opportunities are accepted or intentionally no-op with matching evidence strength and repository scope.
Operational-value observations preserve the ordered metrics published by gh-aw for each workflow run.
uncertainties: A successful run does not by itself prove the durable review output was accepted.
Pending or ignored safe outputs do not establish attained work-item resolution.
A null operational-value metric must remain distinct from a numeric zero.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve metric IDs, order, native finite values or null, units, and directions exactly as published by gh-aw. Use an attainment-only baseline with null value and null cutoff because this synthetic task has no immutable pre-adoption evidence. Mature attainment only when accepted repository evidence is present for the bound review opportunity; use zero when a completed review opportunity produces explicit rejected evidence; keep missing evidence null rather than inferring attainment.
